summary: Wave 47 — D2D dedicated detail page testing. Backend gating verified end-to-end via pytest (7/7 pass): 401 unauthenticated, 403 admin (not supplier), 404 invalid kind, 401 on printer+paper kinds, sample listing customer price=5100. Frontend: guest -> /login?next=%2Fd2d%2F... PASS (live). Customer (logged-in non-supplier) -> d2d-detail-error block renders with backend 403 detail 'D2D listings are visible to approved dealers only' and 'Back to D2D marketplace' link (href=/dealer) PASS (live). Verified-supplier happy path NOT live-exercised (would require registering+approving a fresh supplier in production data, which the request asked to avoid unless necessary); page render path verified by detailed code review of D2DProductDetail.jsx.

backend_endpoint_GET_/api/d2d/listing/{k.verified_supplier_happy_path: NOT LIVE-TESTED — code review only. Backend code at routes/search.py L199-236 correctly: (a) checks kind in {toner,printer,paper}, (b) requires role==supplier, (c) requires suppliers.approved_at present and is_suspended=false, (d) joins to suppliers for {business_name,city,state,phone,email}, (e) returns 404 if d2d_enabled=false with the spec'd detail, (f) sets is_own_listing=true when supplier_id matches caller's supplier row. Logic is sound; the customer-redirect test confirms the 403 path responds with the expected detail string.

action_items: OPTIONAL live-exercise the verified-supplier happy path: register a fresh supplier → admin approves them → log in as that supplier → visit /d2d/toner/46805c13-91f7-4636-8db1-4e62877d1946 and assert all six data-testids render with d2d_price=4800, list=5100, savings≈300, gst_rate=18, supplier.business_name populated. Optional cleanup: a fresh customer account (qa.cust.w47.elac8650@example.com / Test@1234) was registered during the customer-protection test. Leaving it in place per instructions ('do not delete data') but flagging so main agent can purge if desired.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/search.py L214: the .select(...) uses a Postgres embedded join with column alias 'verified_at:approved_at' in the supplier select string, but the alias is unused downstream (the popped 'suppliers' dict is read by .get('business_name') etc., not .get('verified_at')). Either drop the alias or expose it on the response to let the frontend show 'Verified since {verified_at}'. Currently VerifiedBadge on the page is purely presentational.

routes/search.py L217: the 'd2d_enabled' migration-missing branch raises 503. Good. But if Supabase returns a different error string ('column ... does not exist'), the substring check 'd2d_enabled' may miss. Consider a broader catch on PostgrestAPIError code 42703 (undefined_column).

D2DProductDetail.jsx L142: button disabled condition is `data.is_own_listing || Number(data.stock || 0) <= 0`. Looks correct, but the savings calculation L78 uses `data.price ?? data.price_per_ream`. For paper_listings the field is `price_per_ream` — OK. For printer_listings if the field is also `price` you may want a unit test asserting the paper-vs-printer field mapping; right now silent fallback to 0 makes the savings block invisible rather than throwing.

Dealer.jsx D2DCard now links to /d2d/{kind}/{id}, but the card itself still shows the wholesale price d2d_price publicly to anyone who reaches /dealer. Confirm that /dealer is itself gated to verified suppliers (it is, via /d2d/me) — otherwise the card pricing leaks before the new detail page even loads. Current implementation looks correct, just flagging for awareness.

D2DProductDetail.jsx L210: success toast 'Dealer order request placed' fires unconditionally on dialog close (even if user just cancels). The toast should be triggered by OrderRequestDialog's onSuccess, not onClose. Minor UX bug — premature feedback.
